Marta Li: Quick sync: post-launch mini-release decision. We have 2 regressions + a few UX asks. Need P0/P1/P2 picks for next 2 weeks.
Devin Park: Quick intake please: list candidates, impact, rough dev days.
Kai Nguyen: Candidates: 1) Streaming prefix crash (AcmeHealth) - reproducible - ~2 dev-days - high impact. 2) Metrics flush missing for short sessions - intermittent - ~1.5 dev-days. 3) Onboarding copy + CTA - trivial ~0.5 dev-day.
Andrea Gomez: Also saw model-fallback routing hitting slower variant in EU - ~3 dev-days - medium impact on latency.
Samir Patel: My take: Streaming crash = P0. Metrics flush = P1. Onboarding = P2. Fallback routing = defer unless more incidents.
Marta Li: Product criteria: P0 = customer-facing errors/data loss; P1 = degradation or high friction; P2 = polish. Include QA/canary overhead (~1 dev-day each).
Kai Nguyen: PR for crash ready: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/1291 — includes guard + unit test. Will add streaming smoke to canary.
deploy-bot: Canary deployed to staging (canary-18) — https://staging.redwood.dev/canary/18
Devin Park: Plan proposal: Ship P0 (crash) in week 1, add P1 (metrics) in week 2; onboarding copy as optional stretch. Owners: Kai (crash), Devin (metrics), Andrea (copy). Agree?
Marta Li: Agree. I'll create milestone mini-rel-2026-03 and update roadmap board. If blockers pop up we do a 15m sync. :thumbsup:
